roadmap.title: Tower Lobby and Pepperman
roadmap.description: Clear John Gutter, Pizzascape, Ancient Cheese and Bloodsauce Dungeon, then beat Pepperman without a hit.

roadmap.title: Western District and The Vigilante
roadmap.description: Clear the four Western District levels, then beat The Vigilante without a hit.

roadmap.title: Vacation Resort and The Noise
roadmap.description: Clear the four Vacation Resort levels, then beat The Noise without a hit.

roadmap.title: Slum and Fake Peppino
roadmap.description: Clear the four Slum levels, then beat Fake Peppino without a hit.

roadmap.title: Staff Only and Pizzaface
roadmap.description: Clear the three Staff Only levels, then beat Pizzaface without a hit.

roadmap.title: Pumpkin Hunt
roadmap.description: After finishing the game, collect all 30 pumpkins. Outside October 1 to November 14, set the computer clock to a date in that range.

achievements.description: Destroy all the dead john blocks in John Gutter.
achievements.summary: Destroy every dead john block in John Gutter.

steps.text: Smash each @enemy{dead john block} (a block with a face) as you run the main path; none are hidden.

achievements.description: Finish John Gutter in under two minutes.
achievements.summary: Clear John Gutter in less than 120 seconds.

steps.text: Turn on the per-level timer in the settings menu to watch your time.
Run the level fast and start @mechanic{Pizza Time} around the one-minute mark. Restart the run if you are far behind.

achievements.description: Get a combo of 99 or more in John Gutter.
achievements.summary: Chain at least 99 kills in a single John Gutter combo.

steps.text: Start a combo early and keep it going through the whole level, then the second lap.
The level holds 100 enemies counting the second lap, so you need to kill nearly all of them without breaking the chain.

achievements.description: Get to all the priests without bumping into a wall once in Pizzascape.
achievements.summary: Reach all five priests in Pizzascape without bumping into a wall.

steps.text: Reach each of the five @npc{priests} in order; the last one stands just before Pizza Time starts.
Down Thrust in the air to stop sliding as the knight, and bodyslam often so you do not slam into walls.

achievements.description: Parry ten Forknights in Pizzascape.
achievements.summary: Parry ten Forknights in Pizzascape.

guide.context: Stunning a Forknight first makes the parry quicker.

steps.text: Taunt just as a @enemy{Forknight}'s fork is about to touch you. Do this to ten Forknights in one run.

achievements.description: Kill another enemy while in the ball form in Pizzascape.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy while you are in ball form in Pizzascape.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Pepperoni Goblin} standing near another enemy. Grab the other enemy and press Down to place it closer if needed.
Let the goblin kick you into ball form, then roll into the other enemy.

achievements.description: Finish Ancient Cheese without getting hurt by an explosion.
achievements.summary: Finish Ancient Cheese without being hurt by an explosion.

steps.text: Complete the level without taking damage from any explosion. You can skip the Secret Eyes.

achievements.description: Kill a rat using a bomb dropped by an enemy in Ancient Cheese.
achievements.summary: In Ancient Cheese, blow up a rat using a bomb that an enemy dropped.

steps.text: Take a bomb from a @enemy{Pizza Box Goblin} and hit a rat with it. An easy spot is the room after the Tomato toppin, near the second Secret Eye.

achievements.description: Make more than forty one sets of cheese platforms crumble in Ancient Cheese.
achievements.summary: Crumble more than 41 sets of cheese platforms in Ancient Cheese.

guide.context: The total needed is 349 crumbled cheese platform blocks.

steps.text: Play the level normally. You can run over the same cheese blocks again to raise the count.

achievements.description: Finish Bloodsauce Dungeon without touching lava once.
achievements.summary: Finish Bloodsauce Dungeon without touching lava.

steps.text: Never touch lava until the level ends. The Secret Eyes are optional.

achievements.description: During escape, go up with the superjump for more than two seconds in Bloodsauce Dungeon.
achievements.summary: Hold a superjump upward for over two seconds during the Bloodsauce Dungeon escape.

steps.text: Once Pizza Time begins, find the tall shaft linking the pale blue zone to the dark red zone and hold the superjump all the way up.

achievements.description: Finish Bloodsauce Dungeon without getting hurt by a pizza cutter.
achievements.summary: Finish Bloodsauce Dungeon without being hurt by a pizza cutter.

steps.text: Complete the level without touching any pizza cutter. You can skip the Secret Eyes.

achievements.description: Reactivate a totem by dancing with the mach dash in Oregano Desert.
achievements.summary: In Oregano Desert, relight a dead totem by circling it at mach speed.

steps.text: Find a switched-off totem. Mach dash and turn left and right around it until it lights up again.

achievements.description: Kill all of the clerk sausages in the pizzamarts.
achievements.summary: Kill the clerk sausage in all five pizzamarts in Oregano Desert.

steps.text: Enter every pizzamart and kill its clerk sausage. Three are in the main level; two more are reached during Pizza Time, one inside the UFO and one just outside it.

achievements.description: Dont get hit by a single cow in Oregano Desert.
achievements.summary: Finish Oregano Desert without being hit by a cow.

steps.text: Move slowly and jump over each cow at full height; add an uppercut for extra air time.
Skip the two pizzamarts reached in Pizza Time and the third Secret Eye, since cows wait inside them.

achievements.description: Avoid getting touched by the John Ghost in Wasteyard.
achievements.summary: Finish Wasteyard without being touched by the John Ghost.

steps.text: Avoid the @enemy{John Ghost}, which appears after you leave the Pillar John room during Pizza Time.

achievements.description: Kill 20 or more enemies as a ghost in Wasteyard.
achievements.summary: Kill 20 or more enemies in ghost form in Wasteyard.

steps.text: Defeat enemies while ghosted. The last of the twenty is a @enemy{Bandito Chicken} that only shows up in Pizza Time.
The second Secret Eye and second-lap enemies add more kills if you are short.

achievements.description: Surf every corpse in Wasteyard.
achievements.summary: Surf on every corpse in Wasteyard.

steps.text: Ride each of the ten corpses on the main path.

achievements.description: Kill three unreachable enemies at once with the supertaunt in Fun Farm.
achievements.summary: Use one supertaunt in Fun Farm to defeat three enemies you cannot normally reach.

steps.text: Build a combo of 10 to get a supertaunt.
In Pizza Time, find the room where four @enemy{Peasantos} sit beneath the floor and supertaunt there.

achievements.description: Find and destroy the Mort Cube.
achievements.summary: Find and destroy the Mort Cube in Fun Farm.

steps.text: Go to the second room that has Mort Hooks; the cube sits below the farthest ledge on the right.
Swing Mort at it to break it.

achievements.description: Complete Fun Farm while avoiding getting hurt with Mort on you.
achievements.summary: Finish Fun Farm without being hurt while Mort is on you.

steps.text: Keep Mort with you and avoid all damage, including falling into pits.
Catching fire from a Peasanto's torch is not counted as damage.

achievements.description: Destroy nearly every beer bottle in Fastfood Saloon.
achievements.summary: Destroy at least 58 of the 61 beer bottles in Fastfood Saloon.

steps.text: Break bottles all through the level; you can miss up to three.

achievements.description: Activate each button only once in Fastfood Saloon.
achievements.summary: Press every Fastfood Saloon button, but never the same one twice.

steps.text: Hit every normal button once. Buttons in secret rooms are not needed.
A button that you touch twice ruins the run, and running into one often triggers it twice. Stand over it and then run the other way.
During Pizza Time, in the room that held a key, take the ladder down so you do not hit the Timed Gate Button twice.

achievements.description: Touch every single card in Fastfood Saloon.
achievements.summary: Touch every card in Fastfood Saloon.

steps.text: Collect each card in the level. Cards in secret rooms are not required.

achievements.description: Kill a cannon goblin with his own bomb in Crust Cove.
achievements.summary: Kill a cannon goblin with its own cannonball in Crust Cove.

steps.text: Taunt to parry the cannonball, which sends it back into the @enemy{Cannon Pizza Goblin} that shot it.

achievements.description: Uncover all the treasure guys in Crust Cove.
achievements.summary: Uncover all seven treasure guys in Crust Cove.

guide.context: Each treasure guy hides under a red X on the ground. You do not need to defeat them.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Crust Cove} start, just right of the exit gate
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 2
collectibles.location: Start of the second room, top of the left cliff
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 3
collectibles.location: On the platform left of the Tower Secret Treasure door
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 4
collectibles.location: Under the Toppin cage in the room of the first @enemy{Captain Pizza Goblin}
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 5
collectibles.location: In the little pit just ahead of the barrel, past the long water slide and the Cannon Goblinbots
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 6
collectibles.location: On a platform past the second ladder, at the far end of the Cannon Goblinbot hall
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

collectibles.name: Treasure guy 7
collectibles.location: Pizza Time only: beside the second priest on the left, by the Present that leaves the cave
collectibles.method: Dig up the red X.

achievements.description: Complete Crust Cove without getting hit by an explosion.
achievements.summary: Finish Crust Cove without being hit by an explosion.

steps.text: Avoid every goblin bomb and captain cannon for the whole level. You can skip the Secret Eyes.

achievements.description: Stand next to a bee and taunt in Gnome Forest.
achievements.summary: Taunt next to a bee in Gnome Forest.

steps.text: Stand next to a bee, such as the ones in the first room, and taunt.

achievements.description: Destroy every wood block in Gnome Forest.
achievements.summary: Break all of the wood blocks in Gnome Forest.

steps.text: Break all wood blocks in the level, including the ones in the second-lap room. None are in secrets.

achievements.description: Kill a noise goblin with his own arrow in Gnome Forest.
achievements.summary: Kill a noise goblin with its own arrow in Gnome Forest.

steps.text: Parry the arrow a @enemy{Noise Goblin} shoots so it flies back and hits that goblin.

achievements.description: Avoid hitting the ceiling during the room right after the John Pillar in Deep Dish Nine.
achievements.summary: In Deep Dish Nine, do not bump the ceiling in the room that follows Pillar John.

steps.text: Once Pizza Time starts, cross the next room without bonking your head. Running up the wall with mach run is easier than using the bubble.

achievements.description: Destroy all asteroids in Deep Dish Nine.
achievements.summary: Destroy every asteroid in Deep Dish Nine.

steps.text: Break all asteroids. One hidden asteroid blocks the third Secret Eye.

achievements.description: Kill 5 UFOlives in a single bodyslam in Deep Dish Nine.
achievements.summary: One bodyslam in Deep Dish Nine must defeat five UFOlives.

steps.text: On the first planet, go to the third room and drop onto the column of five @enemy{UFOlives} with a bodyslam.

achievements.description: Get the highest rank in the courses of Golf.
achievements.summary: Get the top rank, Primo Burg, on every Golf course.

steps.text: Get Greaseball into the goal in few strokes. Run into him to send him much farther than a normal hit.
Playing as The Noise only needs you to finish each course.

achievements.description: Kill three or more enemies in a single stroke in Golf.
achievements.summary: Defeat at least three enemies with one swing of the ball in Golf.

steps.text: In the Final Course, hit Greaseball straight right to kill two enemies. Then keep him close to the still @enemy{Golf Demon} so he walks into it.

achievements.description: Get a burger enemy to hit the ball inside the goal in Golf.
achievements.summary: In Golf, make a burger enemy knock the ball into the goal.

guide.context: The burger needs to make the last stroke.

steps.text: On the Soda Course, bring a @enemy{Burger Golfer} to the end and let it hit Greaseball toward a @enemy{Big Cheese}, who throws him into the net.
Another way is to pick up a Burger Golfer and crouch to set it down by the ball.

achievements.description: Find the bacon room.
achievements.summary: Find the bacon room in Pig City.

steps.text: In the third Taxi room, look up above the fake Taxi for two bacon strips dangling from the ceiling.
Superjump between the strips to reveal the door.

achievements.description: Kill three or more enemies with a single Brick ball in Pig City.
achievements.summary: Kill three or more enemies with one Brick ball in Pig City.

guide.context: A second spot is before the Pillar John room, where three Pizza Slugs line up; keep moving so Brick does not hit the screen edge.

steps.text: After you switch to @npc{Gustavo} and @npc{Brick}, wait in the small pit until three @enemy{Shrimp Thugs} line up, then knock Brick into them.

achievements.description: Take a photo with every Pig City citizen.
achievements.summary: Take a photo with every one of the 13 Pig City citizens.

steps.text: Taunt next to each pig citizen along the main path. Dancing pigs, police pigs, and pigs in taxi areas or secrets do not count.

achievements.description: Avoid killing any pizzaboy cardboard in Oh Shit!
achievements.summary: Finish Oh Shit! without killing a real pizzaboy cardboard cutout.

steps.text: Walk near each cutout to tell a real pizzaboy from a ninja in disguise. Destroy only the ninjas.
Red ninjas look just like normal pizzaboys, so leave red cutouts alone. Do not supertaunt, since it destroys cutouts.

achievements.description: Kill ten ninjas by parrying them in Oh Shit!
achievements.summary: Parry-kill ten ninjas in Oh Shit!.

steps.text: Parry the jump attack of each @enemy{Ninja Slice} as it leaves its disguise.

achievements.description: Avoid getting grabbed by Mr Pinch during the escape sequence of Oh Shit!
achievements.summary: Do not let Mr Pinch catch you in the Oh Shit! escape.

steps.text: During Pizza Time, superjump into the door to the tight sewer section to skip a trash-jumping part that needs a pinch.

achievements.description: Remove the boxxed form from each priest at least once in Peppibot Factory.
achievements.summary: Remove the box form from each of the four priests in Peppibot Factory.

guide.context: The third Secret Eye must be completed or one priest cannot be reached.

steps.text: Meet each @npc{priest} while wearing the box transformation. Priest 3 comes straight after priest 2 and no box transformation sits between the two.
Open the secret next to priest 2 to reach priest 3, then go back for the box form and use priest 2. Or take the normal route on one lap and the secret route on another.
Do not get hurt before you finish, because damage removes the box form.

achievements.description: Survive the first secret of Peppibot Factory without getting hurt.
achievements.summary: Take no damage during the first secret in Peppibot Factory.

steps.text: Enter the first secret and supertaunt right away, then run to the left wall to avoid the attacks.
Defeat all eleven @enemy{Elite Weenies} before leaving.

achievements.description: Destroy every Peppino robot in Peppibot Factory.
achievements.summary: Wreck every Peppino robot in Peppibot Factory, missing at most one, counting the second lap.

steps.text: Kill the robots on the main path, then do a second lap so you kill each escape robot on both laps. You may miss one.

achievements.description: Free all the frozen birds in Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator.
achievements.summary: Free all twelve frozen birds in Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator.

steps.text: Break ice blocks that show a bird frozen inside, using the jetpack or the Pepper Pizza power-up.

achievements.description: Kill 5 fake santas in Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator .
achievements.summary: Kill five fake santas in Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator.

guide.context: The Pepper Pizza power-up cannot grab enemies, so use a supertaunt or lure a fake santa into a pit.

steps.text: Kill the first two by throwing or uppercutting an enemy into them. Use a supertaunt for the other three.
If you still lack kills at the exit, play a second lap without the power-up and use thrown enemies or a supertaunt.

achievements.description: Complete Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator without falling in a pit.
achievements.summary: Finish Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator without falling into a pit.

guide.context: As The Noise you start with the flying ability.

steps.text: Go slowly, because there are sudden drops. Once you have the flying power-up, hold jump to stay up.
Pits in secret rooms count too.

achievements.description: Kill thirty ghosts in Pizzascare.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 ghosts in Pizzascare.

steps.text: Kill ghosts on the way using the cross. If you are short, the third Secret Eye has 19 Ghostknights.

achievements.description: Avoid getting hurt by the King Ghost's traps in Pizzascare.
achievements.summary: Finish Pizzascare without being hurt by the King Ghost's traps.

steps.text: Learn the map before the attempt. Some parts need mach 3.
The cross makes you immune to the King Ghost's traps, so use it.

achievements.description: Destroy every single skull block in Pizzascare.
achievements.summary: Destroy every skull block in Pizzascare.

steps.text: Smash every skull block. They line the main path, so skip the secrets.

achievements.displayName: And This... Is My Gun On A Stick!
achievements.description: Kill every chasing monster in the escape section of Don't Make A Sound.
achievements.summary: In the Don't Make A Sound escape, defeat each monster that chases you.

steps.text: Use the shotgun to kill each monster; the big chase room first, then one per room. The last is the second Mushroom.
The pineapple is not a monster and does not need to be killed.
If nothing unlocks, run a second lap and kill the monsters you skipped.

achievements.description: Activate the alarms in Don't Make A Sound less than six times before the escape sequence.
achievements.summary: Trigger fewer than six alarms in Don't Make A Sound before the escape.

steps.text: Skip the secrets, since alarms there do not count.

Five rooms have a patroller you cannot avoid: the first Mushroom room, the second Secret Eye room with the Cheese monster, the first Sausage room, the next Sausage room, and the four-monster chase before the shotgun. That leaves one spare alarm.

achievements.description: Avoid getting jumpscared in Don't Make A Sound.
achievements.summary: Never get jumpscared in Don't Make A Sound.

steps.text: Play like a P-rank run, keeping a supertaunt ready. Being caught by a monster removes your combo.
Skip secrets, since being caught ends the run.
Avoid normal taunts, which alert monsters. In the escape, kill the pineapple quickly.

achievements.description: Don't get hurt more than three times in WAR.
achievements.summary: Finish WAR without being hurt more than three times.

steps.text: Kill tanks quickly and use the shotgun freely; it can also shoot down a tank's pizza shot. Skip secrets.

achievements.description: Don't miss more than three shots in WAR.
achievements.summary: Finish WAR without missing more than three shots.

steps.text: Only fire when you will hit an enemy, breakable block, target block, or computer. Shooting down at nothing is a miss.
Use the Dive Drop rather than shooting when you can.

achievements.description: Finish WAR with more than a minute left.
achievements.summary: Finish WAR with more than one minute left on the timer.

steps.text: Skip secrets and collectibles. Jump before shooting to keep speed, and ram enemies except tanks, which you shoot on sight.

achievements.description: Defeat Pepperman without being hurt.
achievements.summary: Defeat Pepperman without being hurt.

guide.context: Both stages have 10 health.

steps.text: Stay far from Pepperman during his bodyslams. He flings himself toward you.
At 2-1 health, hit the marble blocks that spawn to make a statue that leaves him open.

achievements.description: Defeat The Vigilante without being hurt.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Vigilante without being hurt.

guide.context: Both stages have 9 health. Stage 2 is dark and spawns cows.

steps.text: Charge a shot while he is invulnerable, fire it, then follow with two normal shots.
Kill the ghost, cardboard cowboys, and cows fast. His dynamite only hurts when it explodes.

achievements.description: Defeat The Noise without being hurt.
achievements.summary: Defeat The Noise without being hurt.

guide.context: Both stages have 8 health. In stage 2, his minions behave like forknights and hitting him with one stuns him.

steps.text: Parry the bombs he tosses during the hot-air balloon attack.
On the skateboard attack, jump and uppercut to stay safe.

achievements.description: Defeat Fake Peppino without being hurt.
achievements.summary: Defeat Fake Peppino without being hurt.

guide.context: Both stages have 6 health.

steps.text: Attack him when he appears to remove one of the two dashes needed to stun him.
In stage 2, do not attack right as it begins; he dashes and it cannot be parried.

achievements.description: Defeat Pizzaface without being hurt.
achievements.summary: Defeat Pizzaface without being hurt.

guide.context: Stages 1 and 2 have 10 health each, stage 3 is a mini boss rush with 16 total health, and stage 4 has 6. It is the longest boss fight.

steps.text: Stage 1: when you hit him, aim away from one enemy so it survives. Save that enemy for a follow-up hit on his second-to-last life.
Stage 2: stay on the far left or right, watch the cog, and parry the SMG shot.
Stage 3 is a mini boss rush; stage 4: dash away from his leaps.

achievements.description: Get all S Ranks in World 1.
achievements.summary: Get an S rank in every World 1 level.

guide.context: Bosses do not count; P ranks count as S ranks.

steps.text: S-rank John Gutter.
S-rank Pizzascape.
S-rank Ancient Cheese.
S-rank Bloodsauce Dungeon.

achievements.description: Get all S Ranks in World 2.
achievements.summary: Get an S rank in every World 2 level.

guide.context: Bosses do not count; P ranks count as S ranks.

steps.text: S-rank Oregano Desert.
S-rank Wasteyard.
S-rank Fun Farm.
S-rank Fastfood Saloon.

achievements.description: Get all S Ranks in World 3.
achievements.summary: Get an S rank in every World 3 level.

guide.context: Bosses do not count; P ranks count as S ranks.

steps.text: S-rank Crust Cove.
S-rank Gnome Forest.
S-rank Deep Dish Nine.
S-rank Golf.

achievements.description: Get all S Ranks in World 4.
achievements.summary: Get an S rank in every World 4 level.

guide.context: Bosses do not count; P ranks count as S ranks.

steps.text: S-rank The Pig City.
S-rank Oh Shit!.
S-rank Peppibot Factory.
S-rank Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator.

achievements.description: Get all S Ranks in World 5.
achievements.summary: Get an S rank in every World 5 level.

guide.context: Bosses do not count; P ranks count as S ranks.

steps.text: S-rank Pizzascare.
S-rank Don't Make A Sound.
S-rank WAR.

achievements.description: Get all P Ranks in World 1.
achievements.summary: Get a P rank in every World 1 level.

guide.context: A P rank needs, in one run: a combo started before the first room and never broken, enough points for S rank, all 3 Secret Eyes, the Tower Secret Treasure, and Lap 2.

steps.text: P-rank John Gutter.
P-rank Pizzascape.
P-rank Ancient Cheese.
P-rank Bloodsauce Dungeon.

achievements.description: Get all P Ranks in World 2.
achievements.summary: Get a P rank in every World 2 level.

guide.context: A P rank needs, in one run: a combo started before the first room and never broken, enough points for S rank, all 3 Secret Eyes, the Tower Secret Treasure, and Lap 2.

steps.text: P-rank Oregano Desert.
P-rank Wasteyard.
P-rank Fun Farm.
P-rank Fastfood Saloon.

achievements.description: Get all P Ranks in World 3.
achievements.summary: Get a P rank in every World 3 level.

guide.context: A P rank needs, in one run: a combo started before the first room and never broken, enough points for S rank, all 3 Secret Eyes, the Tower Secret Treasure, and Lap 2.

steps.text: P-rank Crust Cove.
P-rank Gnome Forest.
P-rank Deep Dish Nine.
P-rank Golf.

achievements.description: Get all P Ranks in World 4.
achievements.summary: Get a P rank in every World 4 level.

guide.context: A P rank needs, in one run: a combo started before the first room and never broken, enough points for S rank, all 3 Secret Eyes, the Tower Secret Treasure, and Lap 2.

steps.text: P-rank The Pig City.
P-rank Oh Shit!.
P-rank Peppibot Factory.
P-rank Refrigerator-Refrigerador-Freezerator.

achievements.description: Get all P Ranks in World 5.
achievements.summary: Get a P rank in every World 5 level.

guide.context: A P rank needs, in one run: a combo started before the first room and never broken, enough points for S rank, all 3 Secret Eyes, the Tower Secret Treasure, and Lap 2.

steps.text: P-rank Pizzascare.
P-rank Don't Make A Sound.
P-rank WAR.

achievements.description: Find all of the hidden pumpkins in the game.
achievements.summary: Find all 30 hidden pumpkins in the game.

guide.context: Pumpkins show up only once you have beaten the game, and only while the Pumpkin Hunt event runs (October 1 to November 14). At other times, set your computer clock to a date in that window. Taking a pumpkin counts even if you leave the level right away. Twenty pumpkins open the Tower Lobby door to Tricky Treat, which holds the last 10.

collectibles.name: John Gutter pumpkin
collectibles.location: Right before the superjump into the third section, on a platform with two @enemy{Cheeseslimes}
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Pizzascape pumpkin
collectibles.location: Entrance of the Tower Secret Treasure door room, on its far-left wall
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Ancient Cheese pumpkin
collectibles.location: Next room after Pillar John, on the first stretch of ceiling
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Bloodsauce Dungeon pumpkin
collectibles.location: Below the third Secret Eye's entrance, on the floor
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Oregano Desert pumpkin
collectibles.location: In Pizza Time, beyond the cliff-cow room, on the left near where you enter
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Wasteyard pumpkin
collectibles.location: Second Secret Eye room, ahead of the priest, lying on the floor
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Fun Farm pumpkin
collectibles.location: In Pizza Time, in the four-Peasanto room, stuck to the ceiling over the second Peasanto
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Fastfood Saloon pumpkin
collectibles.location: In the second Horsey chase, inside a low tunnel under a platform after the fans
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Crust Cove pumpkin
collectibles.location: Room after the first Captain Pizza Goblin, above where you land after the water current
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Gnome Forest pumpkin
collectibles.location: The room preceding the second Gnome Pizza, beside the exit underneath a platform
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Deep Dish Nine pumpkin
collectibles.location: Just after the first rocket flight, at the room's end below a platform
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: Golf pumpkin
collectibles.location: Soda Course goal area, in the stretch with a large Pizza Topping and a Golf Demon
collectibles.method: Walk toward the quiet music until the pumpkin fades into view, then touch it.

collectibles.name: The Pig City pumpkin
collectibles.location: Once you play Gustavo and Brick, on the left inside the pit holding three Shrimp Thugs

achievements.description: Get all of the pumpkins in Tricky Treat in one run.
achievements.summary: Take every one of the ten Tricky Treat pumpkins during a single attempt.

guide.context: Tricky Treat is only open during the Pumpkin Hunt event, from October 1 to November 14. Outside those dates, set your computer clock to a date in that range.

steps.text: Collect 20 pumpkins first to open the pumpkin door in the Tower Lobby, left of the Chef Tasks entrance, then enter Tricky Treat.
Take the five extra-area pumpkins (blue arrows) first, then the five main-path pumpkins (green arrows).
Stay away from the @enemy{Pumpkin Ghost}; touching it sends you back to the Tower Lobby, and you can retry as often as you need.
